LanguageData.SEC_Recipe_Rabbit_Stew.label: cook rabbit stew x4
LanguageData.SEC_Recipe_Rabbit_Stew.description: Traditional Alfau cuisine. On the Alfau Peninsula, there are no other land animals besides lagomorpha. Various rabbits occupy all ecological niches, they are primary consumers, predators and the Alfaus' main source of meat. So Alfaus invented various dishes with rabbit meat, stewing is one of the main forms. Due to the widespread consumption of stews during the Great Famine in ancient Alfau, nowadays Alfaus still have a special view on stews.
